name: Whistle (16.9 MB speech model)

lineage.base_model: shares the block code of Cactus's Needle model (Simple Attention blocks), trained separately (blog)

purpose: Speech recognition, word timestamps and speech embeddings in one 16.9 MB file for mobiles, wearables, robots, smart home, automotive and microcontrollers, on the same CPU engine as Needle (blog, 2026-10-02).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card header states apache-2.0; no LICENSE file opened.

architecture.kind: encoder-decoder: 8 non-causal Simple Attention encoder blocks (conv stem, 375 frames per 30 s) and 8 Laddered Simple Attention decoder blocks (width 512, GQA 8:2, gated cross attention), beam search with keyword biasing
architecture.attention: GQA 8 query / 2 KV heads in the decoder, cross attention in every decoder layer
architecture.why_this_design: Blog: reuses Needle's block code so one binary turns audio into tool calls; every decoder depth from 2 layers up was trained as its own model and --audio-depth selects one at load time.

variants.notes: repo total 0.46 GB incl. checkpoint; the runtime file is 16.9 MB per the blog

engine_support.notes: Own runtime only; the encoder-decoder design is small enough to port.

benchmarks.name: Time to first token, 10 s of audio
benchmarks.variant: Apple M4 Pro CPU, 5 beams (Whisper base 73.2 ms, Moonshine tiny v2 22.8 ms)

benchmarks.name: Decode speed, 10 s of audio
benchmarks.variant: Apple M4 Pro CPU (Whisper base 266, Moonshine tiny v2 262)

strengths: 16.9 MB, first token in 11 ms on a laptop CPU
German is one of the seven languages
Word timestamps and keyword biasing built in
weaknesses: Accuracy comparison is only shown as bar charts in the blog and only against Whisper base and Moonshine tiny v2 (Whisper base ahead on TED-LIUM, AMI and MLS average per the blog text)
Blog uses the other models' published figures for Whisper and Moonshine, not a common run
soft.maturity: Cactus Compute (Needle model family); 91k downloads on the HF API 2026-11-19.

tona_fit.reason: Far below the quality class of the 0.6B to 1.7B ASR models in this database; relevant only as an ultra-light fallback or wake-word-style front end on weak hardware. No numeric German WER available as text.
blockers: no numeric WER, accuracy only as images

sources.note: builder blog: architecture, benchmark text, speed

open_questions: German accuracy against parakeet and Qwen3-ASR class models
